title: Roles, actions and permission checks
routing: Is this about who may do what and how a request's permissions get installed: PlatformRole and superadmin (isSuperadmin, permix.setSuperadmin), Role on a member row mapped to the standard actions (roleHierarchy, roleToStandardAction, getOrgPermissions / getSpacePermissions, capAtRole), the actions on each model (StandardAction, OrganizationAction / UserAction / TokenAction, person-only actions, actorOf / permix.setActor), entitlements as entry lists (wellFormedEntitlements, changeEntitlements, validateEntitlementGrants), installing a request's permissions (installPermissions, installPermissionsFor, permissionsOfUser, userPermissions), route gates (validatePermission, validateSubmodelPermission, placeUnder), or frontend checks (permissions.setup / permissions.check, usePermission / checkPermission, NavItem.access, Button show / disabledText)? Member rows, delegates and who administers a token or integration are `permissions-members`.
